pressure_elevation_temporal_status: Verified in the October 2025 KMA monthly report, PDF physical pages 8-9; Hb is explicitly height of barometer above mean sea level.
retrieval_timestamp_note: HTTP Date values are server response dates, not asserted exact local receipt times.
attribution: Korea Meteorological Administration, Monthly Meteorological Report, October 2025.
limitations: A single paired monthly-mean comparison is descriptive consistency checking, not instantaneous or high-rate validation.
The fixed-factor standard-atmosphere calculation may differ from KMA operational time-varying reduction; monthly averaging and rounding limit interpretation.
Incheon ASOS112 is an explicitly labeled alternative station, not Songdo AWS631 or Incheonyeonsu AWS512.
Published pressures and temperatures are rounded to 0.1; relative humidity to whole percent. No arbitrary interpolation or replication into minute rows.
aggregation_notes: Official PDF physical page3: KST; daily means use 03,06,09,12,15,18,21,24h observations; daily/monthly statistics require at least80% data availability. Complete coverage is not established by presence of a monthly value.
